title: Cloudflare Deployment Configuration
description: Configuration for deploying apps to Cloudflare Workers

deployable.description: Whether this app is deployed to Cloudflare (deploy.yml, and `otta deploy --all`)

previewDeployable.description: Whether pr-preview.yml deploys a per-PR copy of this app. deploy.yml ignores it.

workerName.description: Name of the Cloudflare Worker (defaults to package name)

buildCommand.description: pnpm script to build the application

workerBuildCommand.description: pnpm script to build the Cloudflare Worker bundle

assetsDirectory.description: Directory containing static assets for the worker

verifyPaths.description: Paths under the app that must exist after the build; `otta deploy` stops before wrangler when one is missing

wranglerEnv.description: Wrangler environment to deploy to; `otta deploy` uses it when --env is not given

healthCheckPath.description: Path requested after the deploy (`otta deploy`, deploy.yml); a failure is reported, never fatal

requiresSecrets.description: Optional, additive. Extra secrets for production verify. Placeholders are auto-derived from wrangler.jsonc; add here only secrets not in wrangler (e.g. build-time). Base CLOUDFLARE_* always included.

requiresPreviewSecrets.description: Optional, additive. Extra secrets for PR preview verify. Placeholders from wrangler.jsonc env.preview are auto-derived; add here only extras.

customBuildSteps.description: Additional custom build steps to run
